name: demo-agent
title: Demo Agent
description: Pairs with a user as an on-call SRE to investigate live incidents on Dynatrace demo environments (a payment failure, an image-service slowdown, a Lambda that lost a permission, a throttled Kubernetes workload, and a host disk and CPU problem), exploring together or walking them through an incident report that ends in a handoff, and gives a guided tour of the cloud estate and its bill, using read-only DQL.
